label: Впервые
description: A 10-sentence usage card for впервые (for the first time).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: A first experience. 'Впервые' means for the first time, modifying the perfective 'увидел'. It marks an action that had never happened before this moment.

missions.phrase: Впервые в жизни я летел на самолёте.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Lifetime first. The phrase 'впервые в жизни' stresses a once-in-a-lifetime first, modifying 'летел'. Fronting it gives the experience extra weight.
Strategic focus: Debut. 'Впервые' frames a debut performance, modifying 'выступила'. It is the standard adverb for marking a first public appearance.
Strategic focus: First visit. In this short question 'впервые' asks whether it is the listener's first time here. It modifies the implied verb of being present in a casual register.
Strategic focus: First meeting. 'Впервые' marks the very first encounter, modifying 'встретились'. The time phrase 'прошлым летом' anchors when that first time occurred.
Strategic focus: A milestone. 'Впервые' marks a developmental first, modifying 'сказал'. The adverb highlights an action achieved for the very first time.
Strategic focus: First time, present. 'Впервые' works with the present-tense 'пробую' to mean I am trying this for the first time right now. It conveys a fresh, ongoing first experience.

missions.phrase: Впервые за долгое время он улыбнулся.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First in a long while. 'Впервые за долгое время' frames a first occurrence after a long gap, modifying 'улыбнулся'. It carries a quietly emotional tone.
Strategic focus: Premiere. 'Впервые' modifies 'показали', marking the film's first screening. End placement before 'вчера' keeps the focus on the act of premiering.
Strategic focus: A first feeling. Fronted 'впервые' stresses a first emotional experience, modifying 'почувствовал'. It introduces a meaningful personal turning point.
